cards.name: Stannis Baratheon
cards.text: Insight. While there is a Winter plot card revealed, opponent's characters STR cannot be raised by card effects.

note.text: Text ability updated to allow Baratheon STR pumps to take effect. Printed STR is reduced from 7 to 6 as a balancing measure.

cards.name: Ser Axell Florent
cards.text: Reaction: After you win dominace, if you control the only King character in play, that character gains 1 power.

cards.name: Ser Patrek of King's Mountain
cards.text: Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Ser Patrek of King’s Mountain is participating, if there is a Winter plot revealed, stand him. (Limit twice per phase.)

note.text: Adjusted to twice per phase.

cards.name: Northern Mountain Clans

note.text: Some minor QoL changes here; added ambush (6), changed to non-loyal, and have removed the kneeling condition so it can be used alongside intimidate (or post-challenge kneeling).

cards.text: Ambush (6). No attachments. Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Northern Mountain Clans is attacking, choose X characters. Those characters cannot stand during the standing phase this round. X is the claim value on your revealed plot card.

cards.name: Dragonstone Proselyte
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of a triggered character ability would initiate, move 1 power from your faction card to that character to cancel those effects. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Deepwood Steward

note.text: Minor update to trigger on marshaling, rather than entering play.

cards.text: Reaction: After you marshal Deepwood Steward, search the top 10 cards of your deck for a The North or out-of-faction location. Reveal it, and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: The King's Prize
cards.text:
Shadow (1).
During [power] challenges, set attached character's STR to 3.

cards.name: Accepted Destiny
cards.text:
[baratheon] character only.
Attached character gets +1 STR for each power it has.

cards.name: Dragonglass Mine

note.text: Tweaking to last until the end of the phase, rather than challenge.

cards.text: Challenges Action: If you have 5 or more power on your faction card, kneel Dragonglass Mine to choose a character you control. Until the end of the phase, that character is immune to opponent's character abilities.

cards.name: The Wall
cards.text: While there are more Winter plot cards than Summer plot cards revealed, each character gets -1 STR. Reaction: After the standing phase begins, kneel The Wall. Each character controlled by an opponent with lowest STR in play cannot stand this phase.

note.text: Adjusted passive to require more Winter over Summer to add some counterplay, and has it hitting all characters. To compensate, the reaction only targets opponents characters with lowest STR.

cards.name: Fiery Talons

note.text: Cost reduced to 0, now has a kneel R'hllor cost, and has been made non-loyal (as we have no fears of it being abused outside of [baratheon])

cards.text: Challenges Action: Kneel a R'hllor character to choose a participating character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets -1 STR and placed in shadows if its STR is 0.

cards.name: Wedding at the Wall

note.text: Reworked to a similar goal of marrying the two traits. Since this is simply about gaining traits our aim was to make it fairly easy to trigger.

cards.text: Reaction: After a [power] challenge is initiated, reveal your shadow area (of at least 1 card). Then, each R'hllor and Wildling character you control gains the R'hllor and Wildling traits until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Euron Crow's Eye
cards.text: Shadow (6). Pillage. Renown. Reaction: After a card comes out of shadows under your control, discard the top card of an opponent's deck. Then, if that card is an event, stand Euron Crow's Eye. (Limit twice per round.)

cards.name: Earl Harlaw
cards.text: Reaction: After an opponent discards cards for reserve, discard the same amount from their deck.

cards.name: Blind Beron
cards.text: Reaction: After you win a challenge by 5 or more STR in which Blind Beron is participating, kill him to put another Drowned God character into play from your dead pile.

cards.name: Silence's Crew
cards.text: Shadow (5). Pillage. Reaction: After Silence's Crew comes out of shadows, if you are the first player, stand each character you control with pillage.

cards.name: Kingsmoot Claimant
cards.text: While Kingsmoot Claimant is attacking a player who does not control a King character, Kingsmoot Claimant gains the King trait and renown.

cards.name: Priest on the Docks
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of a triggered character ability would initiate, kill Priest on the Docks to cancel those effects. (Max once per round.)

cards.name: Captain of the Iron Fleet
cards.text: Ironborn character only. Attached character gains the Captain trait. Challenges Action: During a [military] or [power] challenge, kneel Captain of the Iron Fleet and a Warship location you control to have attached character participate in this challenge on your side.

cards.name: Draped in Seaweed
cards.text: Drowned God character only. Interrupt: When a character you control is killed, kill attached character to save it.

cards.name: Deepwood Motte
cards.text: Reaction: After you kneel a location using assault, stand Asha Greyjoy or a Raider character you control. -2 Initiative.

cards.name: Iron Fleet Detatchment
cards.text: Shadow (1). Challenges Action: Pay 1 gold to treat Iron Fleet Detatchment as a Raider character with STR 2, a [military] icon, a [power] icon, and the text "Stealth." until the end of the phase.
cards.designer: Card design by 2024 Stahleck Melee Champion, Alexandre Carry.

cards.name: Writ in Ink
cards.text: Action: During an [intrigue] challenge, choose a House Harlaw character with a [military] icon and have it participate in the challenge on your side.

cards.name: When Men See My Sails, They Pray
cards.text: Reaction: After you win an unopposed challenge, search the top 10 cards of your deck for a [greyjoy] character with printed cost 6 or higher, and put it into play knelt. Shuffle your deck. (Max 1 per challenge.)

cards.name: Damon Marbrand

note.text: Larger update to flip the trigger & reward; we'll keep a close eye on this as its more a test of direction, with balancing coming after testing.

cards.text: Reaction: After a character is discarded from an opponent's hand, that player must choose a character they control and return it to their hand. (Limit twice per phase.)

cards.name: Orton Merryweather

note.text: Some QoL buffs/improvements, particularly in the wording of the passive & triggering on dominance being deterimined to synergise with Regent's Council.

cards.text: Each gold in your gold pool contributes an additional 1 STR towards your total for dominance. Interrupt: When dominance is determined, if you have not lost an [intrigue] challenge this round, gain 2 gold.

cards.name: Podrick Payne
cards.text:
While you control Brienne of Tarth, Podrick Payne gains a [military] icon.
While you control Tyrion Lannister, Podrick Payne gains an [intrigue] icon.

cards.name: Riverrun Besiegers
cards.text: No attachments. Reaction: After a character gains power, it's controller must discard 1 power from their faction card, unless they discard 1 card from their hand. (Limit twice per round.)

cards.name: Clegane Bannerman
cards.text: Pillage Reaction: After Clegane Bannerman discards a card using pillage, choose a card in the losing opponent's discard pile and place it on top of their deck.
cards.designer: Card Designed by 2025 Online Worlds Champion, Jim Hansen.

note.text: Champ requested changes to better suit the text ability.

cards.name: King's Landing Septon
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of a triggered character ability would initiate, return a The Seven character to your hand to cancel those effects. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Jeweled Tiara
cards.text: Lady character only. If attached character is Cercei Lannister, she gets +2 STR. Reaction: After you win an [intrigue] challenge in which attached character is attacking, kneel Jeweled Tiara to discard 1 card at random from the losing opponents hand for every 5 STR in which you won the challenge by.

note.text: Slight rework to discard based on every 5 STR you won by, with Cersei attachment helping that STR amount.

cards.name: Ward
cards.text:
Shadow (1).
Character with printed STR 3 or lower only.
Attached character contributes its STR to your side during [intrigue] challenges in which you control a participating character.

cards.name: Hornvale
cards.text: Reaction: After you win an [intrigue] challenge, kneel Hornvale to have the losing opponent choose a card in their hand and place it facedown under Hornvale. If Hornvale leaves play, return each card you placed under it to it's owners hand.

cards.name: Rosby Road
cards.text: Limited. Challenges Action: Kneel and sacrifice Rosby Road to gain 3 gold. +1 Initiative.

cards.name: A Lannister's Price
cards.text: Reaction: After you win an [intrigue] challenge by 5 or more STR, gain 2 power for your faction. The losing opponent may give you 2 gold to cancel this effect. (Max 1 per challenge.)

cards.name: The Only Game That Matters
cards.text: Challenges Action: Choose a defending character without an [intrigue] icon. That character does not contribute is STR to this challenge.

cards.name: Areo Hotah
cards.text: Ambush (6). Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Areo Hotah is defending, kneel your faction card to have the losing opponent satisfy the claim of that challenge type as if you were the winning opponent.

cards.name: Nymella Toland
cards.text: Action: Choose a character who is attacking or defending alone, and remove it from the challenge. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Dorea Sand
cards.text: Challenges Action: Return Dorea Sand to your hand. Then, if you control fewer characters than each opponent, stand The Red Viper or a Sand Snake character you control. (Limit once per phase.)

note.text: Changing to limit once per phase, so it allows cancels, but does not prevent combinations with effects to re-put her into play (such as Harmen Uller).

cards.name: Sunspear Sentinel
cards.text: Interrupt: When Sunspear Sentinel is discarded for [intrigue] claim, put it into play instead of placing it in your discard pile. Until the end of the phase, it gains an [intrigue] icon.

note.text: Replaced with a new thematical direction, kitted with the same/similar ability. Primarily a decision based on matching more themes of this cycle, and there already being a higher-costed Spy being added this cycle (Dornish Diplomat).

cards.name: Dornish Diplomat
cards.text: Shadow (3). Reaction: After Dornish Diplomat comes out of shadows, search the top 10 cards of your deck for up to 3 [martell] attachments with printed cost 1 or lower, and put them into play.
cards.designer: Card design by 2018 Worlds Joust Champion, Lennart Paga.

cards.name: Shadow City Septon
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of a triggered character ability would initiate, discard a card from shadows to cancel those effects. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Prince of Dorne
cards.text: Unique [martell] character only. Attached character gains the Lord trait. While an opponent controls more characters than you, attached character gains "immune to opponent's plot effects."

cards.name: Manticore Venom
cards.text: Opponent's characters only. While attached character has no challenge icons, treat its printed text box as if its blank (except for Traits).

cards.name: Godsgrace
cards.text: Reaction: After a [martell] character you control gains 1 or more power, if there is a Summer plot card revealed, kneel Godsgrace to have that character gain an additional power.

cards.name: Sunkissed Sands
cards.text: Reaction: After a character is declared as an attacker or defender, kneel Sunkissed Sands to have that character lose a challenge icon of your choice until the end of the challenge.

cards.name: A Game of Cyvasse
cards.text: Reaction: After the challenges phase begins, each player must choose a character he or she controls. Then, remove each of the chosen characters from the game until you win your next challenge.

cards.name: Vengeance for Elia
cards.text: Reaction: After a [martell] character you control is killed, choose and stand any number of Bastard characters you control.

cards.name: Ser Alliser Thorne
cards.text: Shadow (4). No attachments except Weapon. Reaction: After a card you control comes out of shadows, choose a [thenightswatch] character you control. Until the end of the phase, that character gains stealth. (Limit twice per round.)

cards.name: Alys Karstark
cards.text: Reaction: After Alys Karstark stands, choose another Wildling character you control, and have it gain 1 power. If that character is Sigorn, draw 1 card. (Limit twice per round.)

note.text: Reworked to better fit Wildling decks, as she marries into the culture. She still works alongside Sigorn, who also recieved a similar rework.

cards.name: Alan of Rosby
cards.text: Shadow (1). Reaction: After Alan of Rosby comes out of shadows during a challenge, stand a defending [thenightswatch] character you control.

cards.name: Sentinel Stand Garrison
cards.text: While Sentinel Stand Garrison is standing, it contributes its STR to your side during any challenge in which you controll a defending characters with 1 or fewer challenge icons. Forced Reaction: After you lose a challenge, kneel Sentinel Stand Garrison.

note.text: Removed the 1.0.0 reaction to clean up the card effect.

cards.name: Superstitious Steward
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of a triggered character ability would initiate, sacrifice a [thenightswatch] location to cancel those effects. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Recruit at the Wall
cards.text: Reaction: After an opponent initiates a challenge, Recruit at the Wall gains the icon of that challenge type. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Jade Compendium
cards.text: If attached character is Jon Snow or has the Maester trait, its STR cannot be reduced by card effects. Reaction: After you win an [intrigue] challenge in which attached character is participating, kneel Jade Compendium to draw 2 cards. Then, place 1 card from your hand under your agenda.

cards.name: Sent to the Wall
cards.text: Non-loyal characters only. Terminal. Reaction: After the plot phase begins, name a Trait. If the controller of the attached character reveales a plot card with the same Trait during this phase, discard the attached character from play.

cards.name: Skirling Pass
cards.text: While Skirling Pass is standing, non-Wildling characters lose stealth.

cards.name: Castle Black Wormways
cards.text: Shadow (1). Reaction: After Castle Black Wormways comes out of shadows, if there is a Winter plot card revealed, choose a character you control and return it to shadows. +1 Reserve.

cards.name: Pick of the Dungeons
cards.text: Challenges Action: Choose a character in an opponent's discard pile with a printed cost of 4 or lower. Put that character into play under your control. At the end of the phase, if that card is still in play, place it on the bottom of its owner's deck.

cards.name: Shields of the Realm
cards.text: Reaction: After you win a challenge by 5 or more STR, choose a Ranger, a Steward and a Builder character. Each of those characters gains 1 power. (Max once per phase.)

cards.name: Torghen Flint
cards.text: Stealth. Reaction: After a Winter plot card is revealed, put a Clansman character into play from your hand. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
"Winter is nigh, I want no more mouths to feed."
—Torghen to Jon Snow

cards.name: Arnolf Karstark
cards.text: Reaction: After a character or location you control is sacrificed, stand Arnolf Karstark. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Whoresbane Umber
cards.text: Renown. Forced Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Whoresbane Umber is participating, discard the top X cards of your deck. X is the number of plot cards in your used pile.

cards.name: The Merman's Shield
cards.text: Shadow (4). Interrupt: When The Merman's Shield is sacrificed, place it in shadows instead of placing it in your discard pile.

cards.name: Camouflaged Northmen
cards.text:
Stealth.
While Camouflaged Northmen is attacking, each character with shadow cannot be declared as a defender.

cards.name: Woods Witch
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of a triggered character ability would initiate, sacrifice an Old Gods character to cancel those effects. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Ancient Traditions
cards.text: [stark] character only. Attached character gets +1 STR. While attached character has the Old Gods trait, it gains "immune to opponent's card effects."

cards.name: Lord of Winterfell
cards.text: [stark] Lord character only. Interrupt: When attached character would be killed, kneel Lord of Winterfell and sacrifice another [stark] character to save it.

cards.name: The Weeping Water
cards.text: Interrupt: When a character is sacrificed, kneel The Weeping Water to place that card in its owner's dead pile instead of its owner's discard pile.

cards.name: Grey Cliffs
cards.text: Interrupt: When Grey Cliffs is sacrificed, draw 1 card. +1 Initiative.

cards.name: A Necessary Sacrifice
cards.text: Interrupt: When a non-[stark] character would be killed, save it. Then, sacrifice another character.
cards.flavor: "When treating with liars, even an honest man must lie." <cite>Wyman Manderly</cite>

cards.name: Eyes of the Wolf
cards.text: Challenges Action: Kneel a non-Direwolf character to choose and stand a Direwolf character. Until the end of the phase, it gains each challenge icon the knelt character has.
cards.flavor: "They were wargs as well, as you are, and the greatest of them could wear the skins of any beast that flies or swims or crawls..." <cite>Jojen Reed</cite>

cards.name: Khal Drogo
cards.text: Renown. Reaction: After you win a challenge by 5 or more STR as the attacking player, stand an Dothraki character. (Limit twice per phase.)

note.text: Removed the Army target, as it's a little too open.

cards.name: Galazza Galare
cards.text: Interrupt: When the challenge phase ends, gain 1 power for your faction for each player who did not apply [military] claim this phase.

note.text: In attempts to make this a little less NPE (without reducing her potential power), we're allowing opponents to apply [military] to lower the power gain from Galazza. We suspect this actually helps current burn strategies, but it at least gives opponents agency in how much power you gain.

cards.name: Goghor the Giant
cards.text: No attachments except Weapon. While there is a Weapon attachment attached to Goghor the Giant, he gains intimidate.

note.text: Simplifying his ability, and keeping him more in line (but distinct from) Barsena Blackhair

cards.name: Screaming Horde
cards.text: Assault. Shadow (5). No attachments. Reaction: After Screaming Horde comes out of shadows, put a Dothraki character into play from your hand or discard pile. At the end of the phase, if that card is still in play, return it to your hand.

note.text: Replaced with a new Dothraki Army that aligns more with their effects, at a higher cost curve. We made the active decision to only trigger from coming out of shadows, as it allows for a more interesting effect which is less likely to be cheated by the many existing Dothraki cheat effects. New directions are always welcome.

cards.name: Purple Graces
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of a triggered character ability would initiate, kneel another Grace card to cancel those effects. (Limit once per round.)

note.text: Remvoed the [power] icon, in efforts to balance it out a bit.

cards.name: Sons of the Harpy
cards.text: Shadow (2). Reaction: After Sons of the Harpy comes out of shadows, choose a participating character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets -2 STR.

note.text: Now loyal.

cards.name: Aggo's Bow
cards.text: Dothraki character only. If this is attached to Aggo, he gains stealth. Action: During a [military] challenge, kneel attached character to have them participate in the challenge.

cards.name: Blood of Valyria
cards.text:
Unique [targaryen] character only.
Attached character cannot have its STR reduced by card effects, and gains insight during [power] challenges.

note.text: Printed cost raised to 1 to match the value of the keyword.

cards.name: Yunkai
cards.text: Action: Kneel Yunkai and discard 1 card from your hand to choose a participating character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets -2 STR, and you draw 2 cards if its killed.

note.text: Reworked along a similar vein, but single targeted and provides a useful reward if they are killed (likely by burn, but technically by anything).

cards.name: Cheesemonger's Galley
cards.text: Shadow (1). Interrupt: When you collect income, return Cheesemonger's Galley to shadows to gain 1 gold.

note.text: Adjusting its name to match it being a Warship, rather than a Barge, as it matters for design. Name is in reference to Illyrio's nickname.

cards.name: By Sword or By Guile
cards.text: Interrupt: When claim would be applied for a [military] or [intrigue] challenge in which you control an attacking Army or Dragon character, apply [power] claim instead.

cards.name: Toast in Secret
cards.text: Shadow (1). Play only during a [power] challenge. Action: Choose a participating Lord or Lady character. Until the end of the challenge, that character gets +1 STR for each card you control in shadows. If you win this challenge by 5 or more STR, stand that character and have them gain 2 power. (Max 1 per phase.)

note.text: Reworked to still support Lord and Lady cards, but now toward a more interesting avenue of shadow cards boosting STR, and potentially resulting in stand & power. LImited for [power] challenges only!

cards.name: Paxter Redwyne
cards.text: Renown. Shadow (5). Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Paxter Redwyne is participating, choose a location you own and return it to your hand. (You may place it in shadows instead if it has the Warship trait.)

note.text: Card reworked to promote the new Trading with Braavos agenda as well as boosting House Tyrell's mechanics of more cards in hand and placing cards in shadows (without the shadow keyword).

cards.name: The Mad Maid
cards.text: While there are no cards in shadows, The Mad Maid gains insight. Reaction: After a House Hightower character is knelt, declare a cardtype (character, location, attachment, event). Then, choose and reveal a card in shadows. If that card has that cardtype, discard it. (Limit twice per round.)

cards.name: Tommen Baratheon
cards.text: Each participating [tyrell] character you control gets +2 STR during: - [military] challenges, if there is a revealed Noble plot card. - [intrigue] challenges, if there is a revealed Edict plot card. - [power] challenges, if there is a revealed Kingdom plot card.

note.text:
Trait triggers have been changed to better suit available plots and push this version of Tommen into a wider variety of decks.

cards.name: Knight of the Seven
cards.text: Knight of the Seven gets +1 STR for each card in your hand. Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Knight of the Seven is participating, if it has 7 or more STR, stand it. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Brightwater Commander
cards.text: Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Brightwater Commander is attacking, reveal 1 card from your hand, and place it into shadows. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Starry Septa
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of a triggered character ability would initiate, discard 1 power from Starry Septa to cancel those effects. (Limit once per round.)

note.text: As [tyrell] should not have access to easy cancel, this has been adjusted to require a power discard cost, which by design requires other effects to give it power. Many The Seven cards can grant this.

cards.name: Tourney Steed
cards.text: Limit 1 copy per character. Knight character only. Attached character gets +1 STR (+3 STR instead if it is attacking or defending alone.)

cards.name: Morningstar
cards.text: Character you control only. Reaction: After you win a challenge by 5 or more STR in which attached character is participating, stand attached character and remove it from the challenge.

note.text: Reworked toward a new focus of a nuanced removed standing with win by 5, without limit. Should support cards like Chivalry of the South.

cards.name: Horn Hill
cards.text:
During the first challenge you initiate each phase, raise the claim value on your revealed plot card by 1.
+1 Initiative.

cards.name: Arbor Longship
cards.text: Shadow (1). Action: Kneel Arbor Longship to choose a character that is attacking or defending alone. Until the end of the challenge, it gets +2 STR. Then, if Arbor Longship came out of shadows this phase, stand that character.

note.text: Repalcing with a non-unique Warship to support Paxter, as the previous location was conflicting too much with existing locations.

cards.name: Olenna's Stratagem
cards.text: While you control Queen of Thorns, reduce the cost to play Olenna's Stratagem by 2. Reaction: After you win an [intrigue] challenge, choose a non-event card in your discard pile and place it in shadows. While that card is in shadows it gains shadow (X). X is its printed cost. (Max 1 per challenge.)

note.text: Major update, still among the same effect but triggering on winning & granting shadow keyword. QoT makes it free.

cards.name: Praying for Loras
cards.text: Play only if you control a Lady character. Challenges Action: Choose a unique [tyrell] character in your dead pile and shuffle it into your deck. If it is a Knight character, you may put it into play knelt instead. (Max 1 per round.)

cards.name: Theodan the True
cards.text: Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Theodan the True is participating, choose a The Seven character. Until the end of the phase, that card gains renown or insight. (Limit twice per phase.)

note.text: Reworked to , on winning, provide renown or insight to a The Seven character. Baseline this can be used on himself, but can also buff other more useful cards if paired right. Also raised his STR to 5.

cards.name: Sigorn
cards.text: Reaction: After you win a [military] challenge in which Sigorn is participating, choose and stand another Wildling character you control. If that character is Alys Karstark, stand Sigorn.

note.text: Reworked to fit Wildling themes a bit more and his role as leader of the Thenns, and cleaned up the trait situation a fair bit. Still has clearly useful synergy with Alys Karstark, with her recieving a similar rework as well.

cards.name: Hot Pie
cards.text: Challenges Action: Kneel Hot Pie to choose a non-loyal character or Arya Stark. Until the end of the phase, that character gets +1 STR for each keyword it has.

cards.name: Toll Enforcers
cards.text: While Toll Enforces has 2 or more gold, it gains renown. Reaction: After an opponent has initiated a challenge against you, end the challenge with no winner or loser unless they move 1 gold from their gold pool to a card of your choice. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Children of the Forest
cards.text: Insight. No attachments except Old Gods. Action: Discard a non-event card from your hand to choose another card of the same cardtype in your discard pile. Return that card to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
cards.designer: Card Designed by 2024 Stahleck Joust Champion, Alex Carter.

note.text: Only allows discarding of non-event cards.

cards.name: Alert Sentry
cards.text: Reaction: After a character you control is bypassed by stealth, put Alert Sentry into play from your hand (standing), participating as a defender. (Max 1 per challenge.)

note.text: Slight buff to raise its STR to 3.

cards.name: Shadowskin Cloak
cards.text: Shadow (0). Attached character gains stealth. Forced Interrupt: When the challenges phase ends, return Shadowskin Cloak to your hand.

note.text:
Adjustments to cost, and returns to hand rather than shadows.

cards.name: Wooden Sword
cards.text: While you are the defending player, attached character gains a [military] icon. Challenges Action: Sacrifice Wooden Sword to choose and discard another Weapon attachment.

note.text: Changed to better fit what a Wooden Sword could provide a character, whilst attempting to not overshadow existing cards which provide [military] icons, like Syrio's Training or Practice Blade. Aims to act as a defensive tool, which can "disarm" another character!

cards.name: The God's Eye
cards.text: Action: Kneel The God's Eye to reduce the cost of the next neutral or out-of-faction card you ambush or bring out of shadows this phase by 3.

note.text: Slight buff to also allow reducing neutrals.

cards.name: The Riverroad
cards.text: Limited. Action: Kneel and sacrifice The Riverroad to choose a character. Until the end of the phase, that character gains a challenge icon of your choice. +1 Income.

cards.name: Brotherhood's Bounty
cards.text: Play only if you control no loyal characters. Challenges Action: Gain X gold and draw X cards. X is the claim value on your revealed plot card. (Max 1 per round.)

note.text: Changed to a Challengs Action.

cards.name: "Flowers of Spring"
cards.text: Reaction: After a phase begins, each player cannot play non-Song events until the end of the phase.

note.text: Lowered cost to 0, and can trigger on any phase starting. We hope this brings the card into a good spot as an event counter worth considering, whilst still being more on the "silver-bullet" side (ie. can do nothing against decks with little/no reliance on events)

cards.name: Battle of the Bells
cards.text: Each player cannot trigger abilities to cards entering play.

note.text: Changed to plot deck limit 1.

cards.name: Let My Porridge Fly
cards.text: Forced Reaction: After the challenge phase begins, each player reveals their hand. Then, discard each card with the lowest printed cost among revealed cards.

cards.name: Into the Lists
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must choose and kneel a character he or she controls, if able. Then, the character with the highest STR knelt this way gains 1 power. (2 power instead if it has the Knight trait.)

cards.name: Kingswood Ambush
cards.text:
You cannot marshal characters.
Reduce the cost of each card you ambush this round by 2.

note.text: Nerfing to 7 initiative.

cards.name: Searching the Archives
cards.text: When Revealed: Choose up to 3 cards in your hand and place them facedown under your agenda. Then, draw that many cards.

note.text: Adjusting this ability to be a When Revealed, and limiting it to up to 3 cards. We believe this direction should help with balancing, as that "3" is an easy number to adjust to match it's tested strength.

cards.name: Beneath the Red Keep
cards.text: During the challenges phase, players cannot trigger abilities on characters, locations, or attachments, unless those cards have shadow.

note.text: Lowered initiative to 5, and adjusted ability to only work in challenges phase. We believe this should help this plot be useful, but not entirely lock out non-shadow decks (especially marhaling phase economy).

cards.name: Blood Magic
cards.text: When Revealed: Kill a unique character you control. Then, choose another unique non-Army character in your dead pile and put it into play.

note.text: Simplified the ability significantly, notably a big buff & lowered the initiative down to 0. We want to start this a 3g, check if its strong, then consider it back at 2g like before.

cards.name: Raising Taxes
cards.text: When Revealed: Move all gold on characters to your gold pool.

cards.name: Snow Storm
cards.text: When Revealed: Kneel each attachment and location.

cards.name: Sight of the Three-Eyed Crow
cards.text: Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of each card (by title). Reaction: After you play an event or a card enters play under your control, search your deck for a card of the same cardtype and equal or lower printed cost, reveal it, and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.)
cards.designer: Card Designed by 2024 Online Worlds Champion, Superduck.

note.text: Buffing to allow fetching of equal or lower printed cost, of the same cardtype.

cards.name: Sentinels of the Realm
cards.text: You may include non-loyal Guard characters from any faction in your deck. Each non-Guard character you control that is defending alone does not contribute its STR to the challenge. Reaction: When the challenges phase ends, draw 1 card for each challenge type not initiated against you this phase.

cards.name: Streets of King's Landing
cards.text: Your deck must include at least 12 King's Landing locations. You cannot gain power from challenge bonuses (unopposed and rivals). Reaction: After you win a challenge, kneel a King's Landing location to have it gain 1 power. (Limit 3 times per round.)

note.text: Changing downside to disallow power from challenge bonuses, rather than conditional gold reduction.
